framework.name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (TSC 2017, current as of 2022)
framework.description: AICPA Trust Services Criteria — 33 Common Criteria plus Additional Criteria for Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, and Privacy.

domains.name: Security
domains.description: Common Criteria CC1-CC9 covering governance, risk, access, ops, change, and vendor risk.

domains.name: Availability
domains.description: Additional Criteria A1 — system availability commitments.

domains.name: Confidentiality
domains.description: Additional Criteria C1 — protection of confidential information.

domains.name: Processing Integrity
domains.description: Additional Criteria PI1 — completeness, validity, accuracy, timeliness of processing.

domains.name: Privacy
domains.description: Additional Criteria P1-P8 — collection, use, retention, and disposal of personal information.

controls.title: Demonstrates commitment to integrity and ethical values
controls.summary_description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
controls.implementation_guidance: Publish a code of conduct, board-approved values, and disciplinary process for violations.

suggested_task_templates.title: Annual code-of-conduct attestation
suggested_task_templates.description: Collect signed acknowledgements from all staff.

controls.title: Exercises oversight responsibility
controls.summary_description: The board exercises oversight of the design and operation of internal control over security.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a board/audit-committee charter; document quarterly oversight reviews.

suggested_task_templates.title: Document board oversight cadence
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm minutes capture security oversight discussions.

controls.title: Establishes structure, authority, and responsibility
controls.summary_description: Management establishes reporting lines and authority for the pursuit of objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain an organisation chart; document role responsibilities including security ownership.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh role responsibilities
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm security roles map to current org structure.

controls.title: Demonstrates commitment to competence
controls.summary_description: The entity demonstrates commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define security training requirements; track completion; remediate gaps.

suggested_task_templates.title: Confirm annual security training
suggested_task_templates.description: Verify completion records for the workforce.

controls.title: Enforces accountability
controls.summary_description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal-control responsibilities.
controls.implementation_guidance: Tie performance reviews to security responsibilities; document corrective actions.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review accountability mechanisms
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate accountability for security responsibilities.

controls.title: Uses relevant information
controls.summary_description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define data sources used in security decision-making and assess their quality.

suggested_task_templates.title: Validate information sources
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm relevance and quality of inputs used for control decisions.

controls.title: Communicates internally
controls.summary_description: The entity internally communicates information necessary to support internal control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain an internal security-comms cadence (all-hands, change comms, incident updates).

suggested_task_templates.title: Audit internal security comms
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm staff receive timely, relevant security updates.

controls.title: Communicates externally
controls.summary_description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define external comms channels for incidents, status, and audit communications.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review external comms procedures
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate breach/incident comms templates.

controls.title: Specifies suitable objectives
controls.summary_description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable risk identification and assessment.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document security objectives aligned with business commitments and customer SLAs.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh security objectives
suggested_task_templates.description: Align objectives with current business commitments.

controls.title: Identifies and analyses risk
controls.summary_description: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives and analyses risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a risk register with likelihood, impact, treatment, and owner.

suggested_task_templates.title: Quarterly risk register review
suggested_task_templates.description: Update likelihood/impact and treatment status.

controls.title: Assesses fraud risk
controls.summary_description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document fraud-risk scenarios; map to controls; review annually.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review fraud-risk assessment
suggested_task_templates.description: Refresh scenarios and confirm control coverage.

controls.title: Identifies and analyses significant change
controls.summary_description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run risk reviews on org/system changes; document outcomes.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review significant changes
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm risk-impact reviews for material changes.

controls.title: Conducts ongoing and/or separate evaluations
controls.summary_description: The entity selects, develops, and performs evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run continuous monitoring plus periodic internal audits.

suggested_task_templates.title: Schedule internal audit
suggested_task_templates.description: Plan and execute the next internal audit cycle.

controls.title: Evaluates and communicates deficiencies
controls.summary_description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal-control deficiencies to those responsible for taking corrective action.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track deficiencies through to remediation; report to leadership.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review deficiency log
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm closure of past-due deficiencies.

controls.title: Selects and develops control activities
controls.summary_description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks.
controls.implementation_guidance: Map controls to risks; document control owners and operating frequency.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh control matrix
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm controls map to current risks.

controls.title: Selects and develops general controls over technology
controls.summary_description: The entity also selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document IT general controls (access, change, ops, monitoring) and their owners.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review IT general controls
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate ITGCs against current systems.

controls.title: Deploys through policies and procedures
controls.summary_description: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain policy library with owner, review cadence, and version history.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review policy review cadence
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm policies reviewed within their cycle.

controls.title: Implements logical access security
controls.summary_description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.
controls.implementation_guidance: Enforce SSO/MFA, role-based access, and least privilege across critical systems.

suggested_task_templates.title: Verify MFA coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm MFA on all privileged and admin accounts.

controls.title: Authorizes and modifies access
controls.summary_description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new users.
controls.implementation_guidance: Require approvals for new access and access changes; capture approver identity.

suggested_task_templates.title: Sample access approvals
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate approver authority on a recent sample.

controls.title: Removes access
controls.summary_description: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected information assets based on roles and changes in responsibility.
controls.implementation_guidance: Tie offboarding/role-change to automated access revocation; review terminated-user access.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review terminated-user access
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate access revocation within SLA.

controls.title: Restricts physical access
controls.summary_description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.
controls.implementation_guidance: If applicable, document badge access logs and visitor procedures; otherwise mark as not applicable for cloud-only entities.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review physical access controls
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm coverage or mark NA for cloud-only.

controls.title: Disposes of physical devices
controls.summary_description: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data and software has been diminished.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document secure-disposal procedures for laptops, drives, and removable media.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review device disposal records
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample retired assets for disposal evidence.

controls.title: Implements boundary protection
controls.summary_description: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document network/firewall config; enforce VPC isolation, WAF, and DDoS protection.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review boundary protections
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate firewall/WAF rules against current architecture.

controls.title: Restricts information movement and removal
controls.summary_description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define DLP/egress controls; restrict bulk export from sensitive datastores.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review egress controls
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm DLP rules cover sensitive datastores.

controls.title: Prevents and detects malicious software
controls.summary_description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run endpoint detection on managed devices; scan dependencies and build artifacts.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review malware-prevention coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate EDR + dependency scanning coverage.

controls.title: Detects configuration changes
controls.summary_description: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in unauthorized access or use.
controls.implementation_guidance: Stream config-change events to a log store; alert on drift from baseline.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review config-drift alerts
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm drift detection on critical infra.

controls.title: Monitors anomalies
controls.summary_description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that indicate malicious acts, natural disasters, or errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Centralise logs in a SIEM; tune detection rules; document triage runbooks.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review monitoring alerts
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate triage of recent critical alerts.

controls.title: Evaluates security events
controls.summary_description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the entity to meet its objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Classify security events; document severity criteria and escalation paths.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review event evaluation criteria
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm severity classification is current.

controls.title: Responds to identified security incidents
controls.summary_description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain an IR runbook; run tabletop exercises; capture post-incident reviews.

suggested_task_templates.title: Run IR tabletop
suggested_task_templates.description: Schedule and document the next IR exercise.

controls.title: Recovers from identified security incidents
controls.summary_description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document recovery procedures; verify backups; test restore.

suggested_task_templates.title: Test recovery procedures
suggested_task_templates.description: Run a recovery drill and document results.

controls.title: Authorises, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes
controls.summary_description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Require PR review, approvals, automated tests, and a documented release process.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review change-management evidence
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample recent changes for approvals and tests.

controls.title: Identifies, selects, and develops risk-mitigation activities for disruptions
controls.summary_description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk-mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a business-continuity plan; document RTO/RPO targets per service.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review business continuity plan
suggested_task_templates.description: Refresh RTO/RPO and mitigation steps.

controls.title: Assesses and manages vendor risks
controls.summary_description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run vendor risk reviews at onboarding and annually; track sub-processor list.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh vendor risk reviews
suggested_task_templates.description: Renew assessments for active vendors.

controls.title: Maintains availability commitments
controls.summary_description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to meet its availability commitments and system requirements.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track capacity metrics; alert on threshold breach; document availability commitments.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review capacity vs commitment
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm capacity headroom against SLAs.

controls.title: Designs recovery infrastructure
controls.summary_description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet its availability objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document backup strategy, multi-AZ/region design, and recovery infrastructure.

suggested_task_templates.title: Validate recovery infrastructure
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm backup + multi-region design covers critical services.

controls.title: Tests recovery plans
controls.summary_description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its availability objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Run periodic recovery drills; capture pass/fail and remediation.

suggested_task_templates.title: Schedule recovery drill
suggested_task_templates.description: Run the next backup-restore exercise.

controls.title: Identifies confidential information
controls.summary_description: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a data classification scheme; tag confidential datasets.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review classification coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm confidential datasets are tagged.

controls.title: Disposes of confidential information
controls.summary_description: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document retention/disposal schedules for confidential data; verify execution.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review confidential-data disposal
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample disposal records for compliance.

controls.title: Defines data processing standards
controls.summary_description: The entity obtains or generates, uses, and communicates relevant, quality information regarding the objectives related to processing, including definitions of data processed and product and service specifications.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document data dictionaries and processing specs for critical pipelines.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh data dictionary
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm data definitions match current schemas.

controls.title: Defines inputs processing
controls.summary_description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy, to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Validate inputs at API boundary; reject malformed or unauthorized data.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review input-validation coverage
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm validation on critical APIs.

controls.title: Defines outputs processing
controls.summary_description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting that meet the entity's objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Verify outputs (reports, exports) match source data; reconcile periodically.

suggested_task_templates.title: Run output reconciliation
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm exports match source totals.

controls.title: Stores data completely and accurately
controls.summary_description: The entity implements policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications to meet the entity's objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Monitor for processing failures; retry or alert on missing data.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review pipeline errors
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm investigation of recent processing failures.

controls.title: Stores data with authorization and integrity
controls.summary_description: The entity implements policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications to meet the entity's objectives.
controls.implementation_guidance: Use tamper-evident storage (audit logs, hash chains) for critical data.

suggested_task_templates.title: Verify audit-log integrity
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm audit chain has not been tampered.

controls.title: Provides notice about privacy practices
controls.summary_description: The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Publish a current privacy notice; track changes and effective dates.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review privacy notice
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm notice reflects current practices.

controls.title: Communicates choices and obtains consent
controls.summary_description: The entity communicates choices available regarding the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information to data subjects.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track consent (opt-in/opt-out) per user; surface choices in product.

suggested_task_templates.title: Audit consent records
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample consent records for completeness.

controls.title: Collects personal information for identified purposes
controls.summary_description: Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document each PII field and its business purpose; review collection.

suggested_task_templates.title: Refresh PII inventory
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm collected fields map to purposes.

controls.title: Collects with consent
controls.summary_description: For information requiring explicit consent, the entity communicates the need for such consent, as well as the consequences of a failure to provide consent.
controls.implementation_guidance: Where consent is required, capture timestamped, granular consent.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review explicit-consent records
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm explicit consent captured where required.

controls.title: Limits use of personal information
controls.summary_description: The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Restrict access by purpose; log access to PII for audit.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review PII access logs
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample access against documented purposes.

controls.title: Retains information for limited time
controls.summary_description: The entity retains personal information consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Define retention schedules per data category; automate enforcement.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review retention enforcement
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm purge jobs run per schedule.

controls.title: Disposes of personal information
controls.summary_description: The entity securely disposes of personal information to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Verify deletion in primary stores, replicas, and backups.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review deletion process
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm coverage of replicas and backups.

controls.title: Provides access to personal information
controls.summary_description: The entity grants identified and authenticated data subjects the ability to access their stored personal information for review and, upon request, provides physical or electronic copies of that information.
controls.implementation_guidance: Provide a data-subject-access workflow; track requests and SLAs.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review DSAR fulfilment
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm requests fulfilled within SLA.

controls.title: Allows correction of personal information
controls.summary_description: The entity corrects, amends, or appends personal information based on information provided by data subjects and communicates such information to third parties.
controls.implementation_guidance: Provide correction workflow; propagate corrections to integrations.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review correction workflow
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm correction propagation to integrations.

controls.title: Discloses information to third parties per notice
controls.summary_description: The entity discloses personal information to third parties with the explicit consent of data subjects, and such consent is obtained prior to disclosure.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a sub-processor list; align disclosures with privacy notice.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review sub-processor list
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm disclosures align with notice.

controls.title: Notifies individuals of disclosures
controls.summary_description: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate, and timely record of authorized disclosures of personal information.
controls.implementation_guidance: Log every authorized disclosure; surface to user on request.

suggested_task_templates.title: Audit disclosure record
suggested_task_templates.description: Sample for completeness.

controls.title: Maintains records of disclosures
controls.summary_description: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate, and timely record of detected or reported unauthorized disclosures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Log unauthorized disclosures separately; tie to incident records.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review unauthorized-disclosure log
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm linkage to incident records.

controls.title: Has agreements with third parties
controls.summary_description: The entity obtains privacy commitments, consistent with the entity's privacy commitments and requirements, from vendors and other third parties whose products and services are part of the system.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain DPAs with each sub-processor; track expiry and renewal.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review DPA expiry list
suggested_task_templates.description: Renew DPAs nearing expiry.

controls.title: Obtains commitments from third parties
controls.summary_description: The entity obtains commitments from vendors and other third parties with access to personal information to notify the entity in the event of actual or suspected unauthorized disclosures.
controls.implementation_guidance: Require breach-notification clauses in vendor contracts.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review vendor breach-notification clauses
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm clauses present in active contracts.

controls.title: Notifies affected individuals of privacy incidents
controls.summary_description: The entity provides notification of breaches and incidents to affected data subjects, regulators, and others to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain a breach-notification runbook; log notifications.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review notification runbook
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm jurisdictional timelines are current.

controls.title: Notifies authorities of privacy incidents
controls.summary_description: The entity provides notification of breaches and incidents to regulators within required timelines.
controls.implementation_guidance: Track regulator-notification deadlines per jurisdiction.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review regulator-notification compliance
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm last notifications met regulatory timelines.

controls.title: Maintains quality of personal information
controls.summary_description: The entity collects and maintains accurate, up-to-date, complete, and relevant personal information to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Provide self-service updates; periodically validate critical PII.

suggested_task_templates.title: Run PII quality check
suggested_task_templates.description: Validate accuracy on critical PII fields.

controls.title: Implements privacy compliance monitoring
controls.summary_description: The entity implements a process for receiving, addressing, resolving, and communicating the resolution of inquiries, complaints, and disputes from data subjects and others.
controls.implementation_guidance: Operate a privacy inquiry intake; track resolution and timeline.

suggested_task_templates.title: Review privacy inquiry log
suggested_task_templates.description: Confirm resolution timelines met.
